title: Autosave edits with session undo and redo
description: Autosave visible authoring edits recoverably while providing transient session undo/redo and excluding zoom, focus, selection, and history stacks from durable project state.
acceptanceCriteria: Supported template and assignment edits produce a debounced or safely batched durable draft
Autosave status distinguishes pending, saved, and failed states and is announced without stealing focus
Undo and redo change visible authoring values and regenerate the scene
Reload recovers the latest successfully durable draft
Zoom, focused control, current selection, undo stack, and redo stack are not persisted
Autosave failure preserves the last-known-good durable draft and offers retry

steps.details: Define the serializable authoring draft independently from transient zoom, focus, selection, and bounded undo/redo history values.
Record supported authoring transitions as immutable session snapshots or commands, clear redo after a new edit, and cap retained entries.
Debounce or batch durable draft writes with revision markers so older completions cannot overwrite newer edits; expose pending, saved, failed, and retry states.
Provide semantic buttons and keyboard shortcuts that update authoring state, regenerate the scene, and trigger autosave without persisting history itself.
Edit, undo, redo, wait for save, reload, and assert the latest durable draft returns while zoom, selection, focus, and history reset; simulate failure and verify retry.

technicalNotes: Use monotonic draft revisions or equivalent stale-write protection.
Do not announce every keystroke; announce meaningful autosave state changes.
